changes_from_previous: Fixes two correctness bugs in scripts/harness.py found by an independent code review of the installed 2.0.3 skill (Codex): (1) release_issues() only inspected checks with status 'passed' and ignored the 'required' flag entirely, so a failed required check was invisible to release-check whenever another, non-required check covered the same requirement; a required check that is not 'passed' or 'not_applicable' is now always reported. (2) _check_issues() only enforced the check-v2 schema's required fields when status == 'passed', so a bare {id, status: planned} record passed validation, and an explicit requirement_ids: null crashed with TypeError instead of a validation message; all schema-required fields are now checked for every check record regardless of status, and null-vs-missing is handled without raising. A second-pass review (Codex) found that the first fix used dict.get() for the nullable snapshot_fingerprint and executed_at fields, which conflated an absent key with an explicit null and let a record missing both keys entirely pass with no issues; the check now requires both keys to be present (value may still be null). Both bugs, and this follow-up gap, were reproduced before each fix and confirmed fixed afterward. No other source file changed.
